purpose: Machine-readable roster and rule parameters for the fleet repository knowledge + agent-instruction standard, enforced by scripts/Check-RepoStandard.ps1. One authored agent contract (AGENTS.md) per repo; CLAUDE.md is an @-import adapter carrying the RepoWise-managed block; docs/ holds durable curated knowledge; RepoWise (one workspace at C:/Repos covering shmindmaster, sh-pendoah, musa-dev-team, and pendoah) holds derived intelligence; the tracker named per repo is the only backlog authority.

workspace.note: Single RepoWise workspace over C:/Repos. Member paths are relative to that root (shmindmaster/<repo>, sh-pendoah/<repo>, musa-dev-team/<repo>, pendoah/<product>/<repo>). .demo-workspace is not a git repo (media-studio capture output). The fleet knowledge standard still applies only to rostered shmindmaster repos.
